## Highlights

- Fixed: a reasoning-capable AI model (most often via OpenRouter's automatic model routing, but also possible on Groq and Gemini) could occasionally spend its entire response budget "thinking" internally and never produce the playlist, silently triggering many retries behind the scenes. Generation now stops after a few such failures with a clear error instead of retrying endlessly.

## New and improved

- OpenRouter, Groq (and any custom OpenAI-compatible provider), and Gemini now actively minimize internal "reasoning" token usage on every generation request, with an automatic fallback when a specific model requires reasoning to stay on — lower cost and fewer stalled generations, no change in playlist quality.
- Failed generation attempts are now logged with the specific AI model involved, making provider-side issues easier to diagnose from the server logs.
- For Anthropic users: the static part of the system prompt is now cached provider-side, reducing token cost on repeated requests.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
